body.x: INNOWORKS(representative Seon-yeong Han, www.icover.kr) will show varied mobile accessories at CES 2012 held from Jan 10-13.
iCover, the representative mobile accessory brand of INNOWORKS, will release 'Forte' that is composed of Silicon for inner and Polycarbonate for external

'Forte' is suitable for young people who enjoy extreme sports and have many active mass because it has powerful function of impact absorption , also it can be changed as user's individual style with extra clips.
'IDin Case', which means ID card in Mobile Case, can storage the credit card and transportation card simply, and it's a follow up model of iPhone 3G card storage case.
Card storage is convenient and easy and it has wonderful sliding feeling for card. In addition, this case can reduce risk of loss of transportation card as well as improve convenience.
iCover made a splendid achievement of 1000% sales increase in 2011 in overseas market with high-quality and classy design in four years, since 2007 established.

They made a patent license contract with 'Keith Haring' a pop artist of America, and 'Infinite Challenge' the most famous variety program in Korea, and they are rapidly increasing market share of on-line and off-line in Korea.
